title: Silver Sky memo given to Moore as a test

tellings.quote: it was part of a project called Silver Sky because the memo was called the Silver Sky memo. He went and checked it out and found out that was BS too.

plain: A writer named Greg Bishop tells of a document called the Silver Sky memo, which seemed to describe a secret government project named Silver Sky from around the late 1940s or early 1950s in New Mexico. According to Bishop, the memo was handed to a UFO researcher named Bill Moore around 1980 as a kind of test, and Moore says he checked it out and found it was made up too. The story matters because, had the memo been real, it would have pointed to a hidden project tied to UFOs.
